entity.name: Rick (ricktechmecha)
entity.description: Independent developer building open-source accessibility tools for Mexican indigenous languages

projects.name: Lenguas Indígenas MX
projects.description: Open-source pipeline that converts text or YouTube videos into spoken audio in 8 Mexican indigenous languages (náhuatl, maya yucateco, mixteco, zapoteco, otomí, tzotzil, tzeltal, mam) using Whisper + LLM translation + Meta MMS-TTS. Extensible to 1,100+ MMS languages. Funding supports a community-validated open speech corpus recorded with native speakers.

plans.name: Corpus comunitario con hablantes nativos
plans.description: Pay native speakers to record and validate a free, open speech corpus for Mexican indigenous languages
